target.title: fix: redact dotted API key activity previews
target.body:
﻿Closes #99459

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users inspecting Control UI Activity output previews could see a raw dotted API key assignment when a tool emitted config/properties text containing keys such as `app.api.key=...`.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Activity preview redactor already handled `apikey`, `api_key`, and `api-key`; this extends that same local preview rule to `api.key` while leaving the surrounding redaction behavior unchanged. A focused regression test exercises the production `updateActivityFromToolEvent` path that builds the Activity output preview.

## User Impact

Operators get safer Activity previews for config-style tool output: dotted API key assignments are masked, while non-sensitive config lines continue to display normally.

## Evidence

Source-level before proof against the previous Activity preview regex:

```json
{
  "before": "app.api.key=visible-leaked-value-1234567890\nserver.port=8080",
  "after": "app.api.key=[redacted]\nserver.port=8080"
}
```

Validation after the patch:

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.ui.config.ts ui/src/ui/activity-model.test.ts` - 1 test passed
- `pnpm exec oxlint ui/src/ui/activity-model.ts ui/src/ui/activity-model.test.ts`
- `git diff --check`
- `python .agents\skills\autoreview\scripts\autoreview --mode local` - clean, no accepted/actionable findings
